create_FPQuantConfig: create an FPQuantConfig with hadamard group size, forward dtype, and forward method for FP4 quantization
get_FPQuantLinearMethod: get a FPQuantLinearMethod from FPQuantConfig for a linear layer to apply FP4 quantization weights
run_quantized_forward: run quantized forward pass with FPQuant using MXFP4 or NVFP4 dtype for matrix multiplication
build_FPQuant_linear_weights: build FPQuant linear layer weights with qweight, scales, global scales, and hadamard matrices
register_FPQuant_custom_ops: register custom FPQuant ops fused_quantize_mx, matmul_mxf4_bf16, fused_quantize_nv, matmul_nvf4_bf16
